transcript.text: I need to flag a blocking issue before we proceed. During a privacy review this morning, I confirmed that the production events contain tax_id and bank_account fields in three event types. Our approved data-handling rule requires both of those fields to be redacted before storage and requires raw payload storage to be disabled. The current draft policy enables 100 percent sampling, retains raw event payloads, and does not redact those fields. I have not yet filed this finding in the launch ticket, but it needs to be addressed before the policy can be locked.

transcript.text: I need to flag a blocking cost issue. While reconciling the platform invoice ten minutes ago, I found that the production payload volume is expected to cost four times the draft estimate. Our approved operating budget supports exactly 25 percent sampling and exactly 14 days of retention, and a cost alert must be enabled. The current draft policy at 100 percent sampling and 30-day retention would exceed our approved budget. I have not yet updated the cost worksheet, but this needs to be addressed before the policy can be locked.
